data.input_representation: native polarity-separated Gaussian weighted count, 5 equal-event-count slices per interval
data.image_preprocessing: same fixed-mapped shared grayscale endpoints, [0,1], center-padded from 160x128 to 256x256
event_edge_fixes: retain remainder events across five slices

training.objective: official four-scale Charbonnier photometric loss + 10x official second-order smoothness
training.flow_ground_truth: synthetic validation diagnostic only; never passed to model or optimizer
training.checkpoint_selection: none; save the single post-update state

correlation_adapter: Runtime-only pure PyTorch unfold implementation of the official 9x9 spatial correlation call; upstream files unchanged.
fairness: Same shared physical interval, image endpoints, labels, split, seed, model initialization, optimizer, input resolution, and update count for EventGenesis and V2E.
limitations: This is one update on one physical interval, not a convergence or performance result.
The official source targets older PyTorch; compatibility is assessed only for this server smoke.
The center pad is an engineering adapter for the 256x256 model input and is not target-camera calibration.
